bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for Saint Paul Neighborhood Network.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SAINT PAUL NEIGHBORHOOD NETWORK.

$125,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $125,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to the Saint Paul Neighborhood Network to support their work amplifying community voices through programming and education in cinematography, lighting, and editing; storytelling; documentary filmmaking; and other artistic programming.
